goal: Deprecate apps/web as read-only and remove all legacy provider contracts from the packages.
architectureSummary: ModelAdminService and the revisioned registry are the only provider aggregate; credentialEnvelope is decrypted only at the upstream boundary.
globalConstraints: No secretRef or provider-table apiKey fallback

fileStructure.notes: Remove legacy provider stack and provide encrypted runtime boundary.
Package cleanup only after consumers move.

requirementsChecklist.title: Remove legacy provider code
requirementsChecklist.source: SPEC-0005 clean cut and user request
acceptanceCriteria: No operational ProvidersService, ProvidersRepository or providers dual-read remains.

requirementsChecklist.title: Use encrypted provider credentials at runtime
acceptanceCriteria: Gateway only decrypts credentialEnvelope at the upstream boundary and fails closed.

requirementsChecklist.title: Deprecate web as read-only
acceptanceCriteria: apps/web has retained reads and no provider/model writers.

requirementsChecklist.title: Adjust package surface
acceptanceCriteria: Unused legacy exports and dependencies are removed after migration.

rules: Do not remove unrelated API-key concepts
Baseline pnpm verify -c fails before implementation because code-checks reports unrelated unused workspace exports
The current subagent dispatcher has no model or effort selector; executor profiles fall back to the session default

tasks.title: Remove the legacy provider contract from llm-config-service
tasks.description: Delete the legacy provider repository, service, types, dual-read adapter and exports; provide a narrow encrypted credential resolver for runtime consumers.
acceptanceCriteria: No provider persistence type or export contains secretRef or a provider-table apiKey.
The encrypted envelope resolver is server-only and fails closed.
Focused service tests report RED then GREEN.

steps.title: Write regression tests
steps.description: Add focused tests for the encrypted runtime resolver and absence of legacy provider behavior.

steps.title: Replace the legacy contract
steps.description: Delete legacy provider files and wire the smallest new runtime-only adapter.
steps.expectedResult: Only intentional migration references remain during implementation.

steps.title: Verify the package
steps.description: Run focused Vitest, typecheck and legacy-symbol scans.

notes: New ModelAdminService is the provider aggregate.

tasks.title: Migrate gateway provider resolution to encrypted envelopes
tasks.description: Remove secretRef and plaintext apiKey resolution from the gateway and use the Task-A runtime credential boundary.
acceptanceCriteria: Gateway resolves a valid encrypted provider credential only at the upstream boundary.
Missing or corrupt envelopes fail closed without environment fallback.
Focused gateway tests and typecheck pass.

steps.title: Make tests fail
steps.description: Replace secretRef fixtures with encrypted envelope cases and assert failure modes.
steps.expectedResult: New envelope tests fail before implementation.

steps.title: Migrate the resolver
steps.description: Use the server-only envelope resolver and remove secretRef/apiKey lookup.
steps.expectedResult: No upstream provider secret fallback remains.

steps.title: Verify gateway
steps.description: Run focused tests, typecheck and symbol scan.

tasks.title: Remove legacy server and analytics provider writers
tasks.description: Replace RegistryServices provider dependencies and delete Express writer routes/consumers that target the removed provider service.
acceptanceCriteria: No server route accepts a legacy provider secret write.
Analytics reads the provider registry without secretRef.
Focused server and analytics tests pass.
rules: Retain only explicitly read-only legacy routes.

steps.title: Identify public read boundary
steps.description: Write regression coverage for retained read endpoints and removed writer endpoints.
steps.expectedResult: Legacy writer expectations fail before removal.

steps.title: Remove legacy consumer wiring
steps.description: Update route options, factory consumers and analytics readers to the new contract.

steps.title: Verify package consumers
steps.description: Run focused tests, typechecks and deletion scans.

tasks.title: Deprecate apps/web as a read-only provider and model surface
tasks.description: Remove mutating controls, mutations and HTTP client methods from apps/web while preserving its supported reads and showing the admin handoff.
acceptanceCriteria: apps/web exposes no actionable create, update, delete, sync or provider-credential control.
Read data remains renderable for admin and viewer.
The deprecated surface directs admin changes to apps/ui and focused web tests pass.
rules: Do not delete read-only model/dashboard behavior outside scope.

steps.title: Add read-only UI tests
steps.description: Cover retained read rendering, absence of writer controls and the deprecation handoff.

steps.title: Remove mutations
steps.description: Delete mutation hooks, API client writers and mutation UI from provider/model pages.
steps.expectedResult: No provider/model writer remains in apps/web.

steps.title: Verify web
steps.description: Run focused web tests, typecheck and build checks.

tasks.title: Remove unused packages and verify the legacy cutover
tasks.description: Clean workspace exports, package dependencies and obsolete tests after all consumers are migrated, then execute the full focused verification matrix.
acceptanceCriteria: Package manifests and exports contain no unused legacy provider package surface.
Focused package typechecks/tests pass.
The final scan has no operational provider secretRef/apiKey/legacy provider service references.
rules: Do not erase API-key concepts that are unrelated to upstream provider credentials.
Preserve generated and user-owned files unless the task owns them.

steps.title: Scan remaining symbols
steps.description: Classify every remaining legacy provider reference before removal.
steps.expectedResult: Every hit is classified as unrelated or removed.

steps.title: Clean exports and packages
steps.description: Remove obsolete dependencies, exports and tests only after consumer migration.

steps.title: Run final verification
steps.description: Run focused tests, typechecks, lint and deletion scans.
steps.expectedResult: Exit 0 or documented unrelated baseline issue.

tasks.title: Remove final-audit legacy writers and default fallbacks
tasks.description: Address every Critical and Important finding from the whole-branch audit before closure.
acceptanceCriteria: No legacy Express model/provider writer is registered outside apps/ui.
Default provider resolution uses only model_proxy_providers.is_default.
Focused route/gateway/repository tests and typechecks pass.
rules: Preserve apps/ui as the sole admin writer.
Do not remove unrelated API-key concepts.

steps.title: Remove registered legacy writers
steps.description: Unregister/remove Express model and provider mutations outside apps/ui.

steps.title: Remove default fallbacks
steps.command: rg -n defaultProvider services repositories packages apps

notes: Created from final whole-branch audit findings.
